newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hopewell down as CREATA plan seen dropped.
newsitem.headline: Hopewell down as CREATA plan seen dropped.

text.p: Hopewell Holdings was weak on Tuesday following reports that the company had abandoned its plan to seek a listing for its transport unit Consolidated Real Estate and Transport Asia (CREATA), brokers said.
"The scrapping of the CREATA listing plan will slow down Hopewell's prospects of improving its financial position," said a reaseach director at a regional brokerage.
The reports also said Hopewell hoped to list its Thai unit but analysts said they were now skeptical about those plans too.
Hopewell shares fell HK$0.075, or 1.69 percent, to a morning low of HK$4.375 before closing the morning session at HK$4.40.

Local newspapers said on Tuesday that Hopewell had abandoned its plan to arrange a listing or placement for CREATA and was now focused on placing stakes and seeking a separate listing for its Thai unit.
Hopewell officials were not available for comment.
